Loading prompts containing terminal color codes from history or an external editor no longer triggers unrecoverable interface crashes. ⟦This is like an automated mail sorting machine at the post office: it flattens envelopes and filters out invisible watermark impurities before letters enter sorting bins, without dropping incoming queued packages while processing previous mail.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") when the prompt held text containing terminal color codes, for example a prompt recalled from history or text loaded from the external editor
Fixed messages typed while Claude is still working sometimes being ignored by the model
Improved prompt handling: invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters in a prompt are removed and the cleaned prompt is shown for review before it is sent

title.zh-TW: 終端機渲染效能穩定提升，全螢幕文字選取複製即時回饋
title.en: Stable Terminal Rendering Enhancements, Real-Time Feedback on Fullscreen Text Copying

body.zh-TW: 慢電腦上剛啟動就當掉、少數情況下畫面停住不動，這兩件事不會再發生。在電腦高負載時啟動工作階段，介面不再因為首次顯示旋轉載入圖示而崩潰退出。內部渲染錯誤後螢幕可能停止刷新的問題已排除，確保畫面在整個工作階段期間持續即時更新。在全螢幕的 `/resume` 工作階段選擇器與其他覆蓋輸入區的面板中，透過滑鼠拖曳選取文字後，已能正常顯示已複製的提示通知。啟動時商標下方的過長通知提示行，改為以隱藏 N 則通知的簡明文字呈現。⟦這宛如機場大廳的高解析航班看板，即使人潮擁擠時開啟電源也不會黑屏當機，滑鼠選取航班代碼時也會即時彈出複製完成的提示。⟧
body.en: Crashing right after launch on slow machines and, in rare cases, a screen that stops updating: neither happens anymore. Launching sessions under heavy system load no longer crashes with unrecoverable interface errors when the initial spinner appears. A rare issue where the screen could stop updating for the rest of the session after an internal rendering error has been eliminated, ensuring continuous live updates. In the fullscreen `/resume` session picker and other panels covering the prompt area, drag-selecting text with the mouse now reliably displays the copied notice. Startup overflow lines under the logo now concisely show how many notices are hidden. ⟦This is like a high-resolution airport departure board: turning on power during crowded peak hours does not result in a black screen crash, and selecting flight codes with a mouse instantly triggers a copied notification.⟧

items.original:
Fixed sessions on slow or heavily loaded machines sometimes exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" when the first spinner appeared
Fixed a rare case where the screen could stop updating for the rest of the session after an internal rendering error
Fixed the "copied" notice not appearing after drag-selecting text in the fullscreen `/resume` picker and other panels that cover the prompt area
Improved the startup notice overflow line under the logo: it now reads "N more notices hidden" instead of "+N more · /status"

title.zh-TW: 審查指令指引更智慧，模型清單常駐並精確回報拒絕原因
title.en: Smarter Code Review Command Guidance, Persistent Model Listings with Clear Refusal Explanations

body.zh-TW: 執行程式碼審查指令 `/ultrareview` 時，若無待審變更，介面會說明情境並提供審查最新提交紀錄的指令，對新套件庫的首個提交也會完整審查；非互動環境中若無基礎分支或共同歷史則會明確拒絕。在 Anthropic API 模式下，`/model` 清單一律會顯示 Fable 模型，僅在組織停用時反灰。在 Cowork 雲端工作階段中，`WebFetch` 網頁擷取與 `WebSearch` 搜尋工具在請求被拒時會明確告知 Claude 具體原因，例如額度用盡或管理員策略限制。Windows 上回覆後因記憶體不足導致工具呼叫未執行的問題也已修復。⟦這好比報社的審稿總監，桌面沒有新投稿時會主動提議複審最新專欄，調閱權限不足時也會標明原因。⟧
body.en: When running the code review command `/ultrareview` with nothing to review, the interface now explains the context and offers a command to review your latest commit, while the first commit in a new repository is reviewed in full; in non-interactive sessions, it explicitly refuses when the repository lacks a base branch or shared history. On the Anthropic API, Fable now always appears in the `/model` list, appearing greyed out only when disabled by organization settings. In Cowork cloud sessions, `WebFetch` and `WebSearch` now clearly inform Claude of the exact reason when requests are refused, such as a used-up fetch budget or admin policy restrictions. An issue on Windows where out-of-memory errors immediately following Claude's reply prevented tool calls from executing has also been resolved. ⟦This is like an editor-in-chief at a newspaper: when there are no new submissions on the desk, they proactively suggest reviewing the latest column, and clearly state reasons when access permissions are insufficient.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a rare case on Windows where a turn could stop with an error such as "Out of memory" right after Claude replied, so that reply's tool calls never ran
Fixed WebFetch and WebSearch in Cowork cloud sessions not telling Claude why a request was refused, such as a used-up fetch budget or an admin policy
Improved `/ultrareview` when there's nothing to review: messages say which case you're in, offer a command that reviews your latest commit, and a new repository's first commit is reviewed in full
Changed Fable to always appear in `/model` on the Anthropic API; it is greyed out only when your organization's settings disable it
Changed `/ultrareview` in non-interactive sessions to refuse when the repository has no base branch or shared history

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 面板選單支援快速登出，背景任務與用量統計全面納管
title.en: [VSCode] Panel Menu Supports Quick Logout, Comprehensively Managing Background Tasks and Usage Metrics

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡用 Claude Code 的人，這版多了登出、停止背景任務、複製回應等幾項新操作。面板選單中新增了「Sign out」登出選項，並支援在指令列鍵入 `/logout` 快速登出。代理地圖中現在納入了背景終端機與執行中的背景任務，每項任務均配備停止按鈕，並可透過 `/tasks` 指令直接開啟檢視。AI 回覆訊息旁新增了複製按鈕，亦可鍵入 `/copy` 複製完整回覆。閒置的工作階段被自動封存時會彈出單次提示，封存分組中也新增了全部解除封存按鈕。在不適用方案上限的環境中，帳戶用量對話框與工作階段管理器現在會顯示花費與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）使用量。⟦這就像辦公室的高級智慧中控台，將正在背景運作的印表機與碎紙機一併列出管理按鈕，並在公文夾自動歸檔時發出貼心通知。⟧
body.en: If you use Claude Code in VS Code, this release adds new actions such as signing out, stopping background tasks, and copying responses. A "Sign out" row has been added to the panel menu, along with support for typing `/logout` in the command menu. The agent map now includes background shells and running tasks, each equipped with a Stop button, and can be opened directly with `/tasks`. A Copy response button is now available beside AI responses, alongside a typed `/copy` command. A one-time notice appears when inactive sessions are archived automatically, and an "Unarchive all" action has been added to the Archived sessions group. In environments where plan limits do not apply, the Account & usage dialog and session manager now display costs and token usage. ⟦This is like an office's advanced smart control console: it lists management controls for background printers and shredders alike, while sending a helpful notification whenever document folders are automatically archived.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Sign out row to the panel menu, with `/logout` in the typed command menu
[VSCode] Added background shells and other running tasks to the agent map, each with a Stop, and a typed `/tasks` that opens it
[VSCode] Added a Copy response button on responses and a typed `/copy`
[VSCode] Added a one-time notice when inactive sessions are archived automatically, and an "Unarchive all" action on the Archived sessions group
[VSCode] Added the session's cost and token usage to the Account & usage dialog and the session manager where plan limits do not apply (Vertex, Bedrock, Foundry, API key)

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 設定與功能選單直覺開啟，思考程度與快速模式持久保存
title.en: [VSCode] Intuitive Settings and Feature Menus, Persisting Effort Levels and Fast Mode

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡設好的偏好，以前重開後可能就不見了。點選「General config」選單項目現在會直接開啟設定頁面，鍵入 `/mcp`、`/hooks`（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）、`/memory`、`/rewind` 等指令也能直接叫出對應的設定對話框。透過思考程度滑桿設定的數值，現在會跨工作階段持續保存，不再遺失先前以 `/effort` 儲存的等級。以不同大小寫別名（例如「Sonnet」）儲存模型時，模式選擇器不再遺漏自動模式選項。執行 `/fast` 指令切換的快速模式已能正確儲存為預設值，重新啟動後依然生效。⟦這宛如專業相機的自訂轉盤，將快捷選單與光圈設定精準儲存在機身記憶體中，重新開機後依然維持你最熟悉的拍攝模式。⟧
body.en: Preferences you set in VS Code could previously vanish after a restart. Clicking the "General config" menu item now opens settings directly, and typing commands such as `/mcp`, `/hooks`, `/memory`, and `/rewind` directly opens their respective dialogs. Effort levels adjusted via the slider now persist across sessions on models that already had a level saved with `/effort`. The mode picker no longer misses the Auto option when saved model settings use differently-cased aliases like "Sonnet". Toggling fast mode with `/fast` is now correctly saved as the default, remaining active after restarts. ⟦This is like a custom dial on a professional camera: it securely stores shortcut menus and aperture settings in internal memory, preserving your familiar shooting mode even after powering back on.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the "General config" menu row showing `/config` usage text instead of opening settings, and made typed `/mcp`, `/hooks`, `/memory`, `/rewind` and similar commands open their dialogs
[VSCode] Fixed the effort slider's level not persisting into later sessions on a model that already had a level saved with `/effort`
[VSCode] Fixed Auto missing from the mode picker for conversations opened in an already-used panel when the saved model setting is a differently-cased alias such as "Sonnet"
[VSCode] Fixed `/fast` not saving fast mode as the default, so it was lost when the extension relaunched Claude Code

title.zh-TW: [網頁版] 雲端環境分層管理，支援組織共用與嚴謹網路限制
title.en: [Claude Code on the Web] Tiered Cloud Environment Management, Supporting Organization Sharing and Network Safeguards

body.zh-TW: 在 Team 或 Enterprise 方案裡共用雲端環境，最怕分不清哪個是自己的、哪個大家都在用。在 Team 與 Enterprise 企業方案中，雲端環境選擇器現在劃分為個人與組織兩個專屬區塊，管理員可直接將個人建立的環境共享給整個組織。組織共用環境在 Code 分頁中預設以唯讀摘要呈現，防止非管理員誤觸修改，編輯功能統一移至管理員設定的雲端環境專區。設定為自訂網路存取但未填寫任何網域的雲端環境，不再無聲還原為受信任模式，儲存時會主動要求至少填入一個網域。管理員設定中的標籤已重新命名為「Cloud sessions」（雲端工作階段），並移除了下方多餘的唯讀行動裝置列。⟦這就像共用辦公空間的會議室門禁權限，個人專用室可升級為全員會議室，並將調整格局的權限嚴格保留給大樓管委會。⟧
body.en: When a Team or Enterprise plan shares cloud environments, the hard part is telling which ones are yours and which ones everyone uses. On Team and Enterprise plans, the cloud environment picker is now divided into Personal and Organization sections, allowing admins to share personal environments with the entire organization. Organization environments open as read-only summaries by default on the Code tab to prevent unauthorized modifications, while editing is consolidated under Admin settings → Cloud environments. Cloud environments saved with Custom network access and no domains no longer silently revert to Trusted mode, and the dialog now requires at least one domain. The admin setting label has been renamed to "Cloud sessions", removing the redundant read-only Mobile row beneath it. ⟦This is like conference room access control in a shared office space: private rooms can be upgraded to all-hands meeting rooms, while the authority to alter room layouts remains strictly reserved for building management.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Added Personal and Organization sections to the environment picker on Team and Enterprise plans, and admins can now share a personal environment with the organization
[Claude Code on the web] Changed organization environments to open as a read-only summary from the Code tab on Team and Enterprise plans, with editing under Admin settings → Cloud environments
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a cloud environment saved with Custom network access and no domains silently reverting to Trusted; the dialog now asks for at least one domain
[Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin Claude Code setting labeled "Web" to "Cloud sessions" and removed the redundant read-only Mobile row beneath it

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 排程跨頻道讀取修復，憑證設定表單與連線日誌升級
title.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Cross-Channel Routine Reads, Upgraded Credential Forms and Network Logs

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 裡用 Claude Tag 的團隊，這組修正集中在排程和存取憑證兩塊。在 Slack Enterprise Grid 全組織安裝環境的頻道中建立的例行排程，執行時已能正常讀取同工作區內的其他公開頻道。存取套件中的憑證（用於登入與授權的證明檔案）預設項目上的連結，現在會直接導向各服務供應商專屬的憑證設定指南，而非通用的 API 文件。Pylon 憑證預設項目支援管理員手動指向其歐洲伺服器主機。Google Cloud 憑證表單在上傳金鑰被拒時會具體說明原因，網站與 scopes 會維持鎖定，並在替換被拒時保留貼上的金鑰。管理員設定中的網路事件日誌已修復使用 AWS 簽章、用戶端憑證或自訂憑證授權單位連線時遺漏回應狀態的問題。⟦這好比國際商務中心的數位通行證申辦處，申請表單精確導向各國使館的專屬簽證網頁，遇到資料格式不符時也會保留已填寫的欄位方便重新送審。⟧
body.en: For teams using Claude Tag in Slack, this group of fixes centers on routines and access credentials. Routines created in a Slack channel on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install can now properly read other public channels in their workspace when running. Links on credential presets in Claude Tag access bundles now open each vendor's dedicated credential-setup page instead of generic API documentation. Admins can now point the Pylon credential preset at Pylon's EU host. Google Cloud credential forms in access bundles now explain why a key file is refused, the website and scopes stay locked, and pasted keys are preserved when a replacement is rejected. The network events log in admin settings fixed missing response statuses for connections using AWS signing, client certificates, or a custom CA. ⟦This is like a digital pass application desk at an international business center: application forms direct you precisely to dedicated embassy visa pages, and retain filled-in fields when submissions fail so they can be easily corrected and re-submitted.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed routines created in a Slack channel on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install failing to read other public channels in their workspace when they ran
[Claude Tag] Fixed the "Learn more" links on credential presets in Claude Tag access bundles to open each vendor's credential-setup page instead of a generic API reference
[Claude Tag] Changed the Pylon credential preset in Claude Tag access bundles so admins can point it at Pylon's EU host
[Claude Tag] Fixed Google Cloud credential forms in Claude Tag access bundles: a refused key file now says why, the website and scopes stay locked, and a rejected rotation keeps the pasted key
[Claude Tag] Fixed the network events log in Claude Tag admin settings showing no response status for requests through connections that use AWS signing, client certificates or a custom CA

title.zh-TW: 模型選單支援 GPT-6 系列，限流提示推薦切換 Luna
title.en: Model Picker Supports GPT-6 Series with Rate-Limit Prompts Recommending Luna

body.zh-TW: 當你連續請 AI 撰寫程式碼而發出大量請求時，最怕遇到對話中斷而打亂思緒。在模型選單（挑選由哪一款 AI 回答問題的切換清單）中，現在可以直接指定 GPT-6 Sol 或 GPT-6 Luna。當發送的請求達到上限並觸發限流（短時間內發送過於頻繁時暫停接收的保護機制）時，畫面跳出的切換提示現在會主動推薦改用 GPT-6 Luna 接手。⟦如同騎長途公路車遇到陡坡時，碼表直接跳出該換哪一檔的建議，以前得自己停下來判斷，現在照著提示換檔就能繼續往前騎。⟧如此一來，在密集調度不同模型資源時，便能直接順著建議切換，不必中斷手邊正在進行的開發任務。
body.en: When sending numerous requests while asking AI to write code consecutively, unexpected interruptions that break your train of thought are a major hassle. From the model picker, you can now directly choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna. When outgoing requests hit their cap and trigger rate limits (a protective throttle that pauses incoming requests when sent too frequently in a short period), the pop-up switch prompt now proactively suggests handing off to GPT-6 Luna. ⟦Much like a cyclist on a steep climb whose bike computer now suggests which gear to shift into: before, you had to stop and work it out yourself; now you follow the prompt and keep riding.⟧ This ensures that when juggling model resources heavily, you can follow the suggestion to switch directly without interrupting your ongoing development work.

items.original: Choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna from the model picker. The rate-limit switch prompt now recommends GPT-6 Luna. (#47405)

title.zh-TW: 選用 /tui 全螢幕介面，支援搜尋紀錄與滑鼠右鍵複製
title.en: Choose the optional /tui fullscreen UI with transcript search and right-click copying

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕介面現在是可選的：在 Codex 裡輸入 `/tui` 做選擇，下次啟動時就會改用全螢幕的操作畫面。⟦好比走進挑高寬敞的大型閱覽室，桌面上能一口氣展開整份研究卷宗，想找特定段落直接查目錄，還能隨手拿螢光筆圈選重點並按一下印表機複印。⟧進入全螢幕後，你可以直接用搜尋功能快速翻查過往的對話轉錄紀錄，也能直接用滑鼠游標圈選畫面上的文字，並點擊滑鼠右鍵快速複製內容。
body.en: The fullscreen interface is now optional: enter `/tui` in Codex to select it, and your next launch will switch to a fullscreen operational display. ⟦Picture stepping into a spacious reading hall where you can spread out an entire research dossier across the desk, look up specific passages directly in the index, highlight key notes with a marker, and make instant copies on a printer.⟧ Once in fullscreen mode, you can quickly search through past conversation transcripts, select text on screen directly with your mouse cursor, and right-click to copy content quickly.

items.original: Choose an optional fullscreen UI with `/tui` for your next launch, including transcript search, mouse selection, and right-click copying. (#46732, #46734, #46883, #46895)

title.zh-TW: 語音對話改為預設開啟，附快捷鍵、設定選單與播放修復
title.en: Voice conversations are enabled by default with shortcuts, a settings menu, and playback fixes

body.zh-TW: 雙手忙著寫程式或翻查文件時，開口直接跟 AI 討論變得更自然省事。⟦就像車載免持對講系統在出廠時就預先安裝好喇叭與麥克風，按下方向盤按鈕就能隨時切換通話，而且遇到播放暫停或語音突然大量湧入時，車機喇叭依然會把每個字完整唸完，絕不漏字。⟧語音對話現在預設直接開放，Linux 與 Windows 版本也已內建打包好的音訊執行階段，開箱即可運作。你只要按下 F8 鍵就能開關語音對話，或在對話中輸入 `/voice settings` 開啟選單挑選偏好的語音設定。另外，系統修復了音訊播放暫停或短時間湧入大量語音時容易丟失字句的問題。
body.en: Speaking directly with AI becomes much more natural when your hands are busy writing code or looking through documentation. ⟦Much like a factory-installed hands-free car intercom with built-in speakers and microphones, you can toggle calls from the steering wheel, and the car speakers read out every word completely without dropping speech even during pauses or sudden bursts of incoming audio.⟧ Voice conversations are now enabled by default, and Linux and Windows builds bundle pre-packaged audio runtimes that work out of the box. Simply press F8 to toggle voice conversations, or type `/voice settings` in a conversation to open a menu and choose your preferred voice options. In addition, the system fixes an issue where speech was dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio.

items.original:
Voice conversations are enabled by default, with an F8 toggle, a `/voice settings` picker, and bundled audio runtimes for Linux and Windows. (#44921, #46071, #44622, #44714, #44922)
Prevent speech from being dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio. (#46880)

title.zh-TW: 新增 /usage 分析儀表板，用量、token 與外掛活動一目了然
title.en: Add /usage analytics dashboard to track consumption, token totals, and plugin activity

body.zh-TW: 想知道自己的帳號用掉多少額度、哪些外掛與技能最常派上用場？現在只要在終端機輸入 `/usage` 指令，就能叫出專屬的數據分析總覽。⟦宛如家庭智慧電表配備的即時數據面板，隨時翻看就能清楚查閱總耗電度數、各個家電插座的用電紀錄與每日用量走勢，不再需要等到月底收帳單才盲猜。⟧在這個儀表板中，你可以檢視帳號的整體用量，掌握消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）累積總計。同時，介面還會列出各項外掛與技能的呼叫活動紀錄，方便你評估各項擴充工具的運作情形。
body.en: Want to know how much quota your account has used or which plugins and skills are called most often? Now you can simply enter the `/usage` command in the terminal to bring up a dedicated analytics overview. ⟦Think of a smart home electricity meter equipped with a live dashboard that lets you check total kilowatt-hours, monitor power usage across individual appliance outlets, and track daily consumption trends instead of guessing before the bill arrives at the end of the month.⟧ In this dashboard, you can view your overall account usage and track cumulative token totals. The interface also lists invocation activity across plugins and skills, making it easy to evaluate how your extensions are performing.

items.original: Explore account usage, token totals, and plugin and skill activity through the `/usage` analytics dashboard. (#45764, #45769)

title.zh-TW: 代理人控制中心支援狀態篩選，工作樹建立與支援預設開啟
title.en: Agent command center supports status filtering, with worktree creation and support enabled by default

body.zh-TW: 指揮多個背景代理人處理複雜任務時，追蹤進度與分流目錄變得更加井井有條。⟦如同專案總監巡視工地的中央調度台，不僅能依據施工狀態分類篩選待辦工單，還能為特定小組直接開啟獨立的隔離施工艙，且這種分流作業規範現在一開工就全面啟用。⟧在代理人控制中心裡，你可以依照任務狀態快速篩選待辦清單，並直接針對特定任務建立專屬的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）工作階段。同時，工作樹支援在本次更新中改為預設開啟，讓你在開發多條分支時無須額外設定即可直接享受獨立目錄的隔離優勢。
body.en: Tracking progress and compartmentalizing directories becomes far more organized when directing multiple background agents on complex tasks. ⟦A project director inspecting a site from a central dispatch console can filter pending work orders by construction status and spin up dedicated, isolated work bays for specific crews, with this compartmentalized workflow now active right from the start.⟧ In the agent command center, you can quickly filter tasks by status and create dedicated worktree sessions for specific assignments. Meanwhile, worktree support is enabled by default in this update, letting you enjoy the isolation benefits of independent directories across multiple branches without extra configuration.

items.original: Filter tasks by status and create worktree sessions from the agent command center; worktree support is now enabled by default. (#46839, #45276, #44870)

title.zh-TW: 終端機推出六款新主題配色，支援即時渲染 Mermaid 圖表與數學公式
title.en: Terminal introduces six new themes, supporting direct rendering of Mermaid diagrams and math equations

body.zh-TW: 看膩了預設的黑底白字，或是讀到複雜的流程邏輯只能盯著純文字自行腦補？⟦好似替客廳換上多種風格的新壁紙與沙發套，而且電視牆還能直接播放流程圖與清楚排版的數學公式看板，不必再把草稿紙翻得眼花撩亂。⟧這次更新為終端機加入了六款全新主題配色，讓你能自由客製化視覺介面。更棒的是，當 AI 在回覆中給出受支援的 Mermaid 圖表或數學展示公式時，終端機現在能直接在回答中將它們視覺化呈現出來，省去將圖表程式碼複製到外部編輯器才能預覽的麻煩。
body.en: Tired of the default black-and-white terminal or struggling to visualize complex process logic from plain text? ⟦Imagine refitting a living room with new wallpapers and sofa covers while the media wall renders flowcharts and neatly formatted math equations directly on screen, sparing you from flipping through messy scratch paper.⟧ This update adds six brand-new color themes to the terminal, allowing you to freely customize your visual interface. Even better, when AI provides supported Mermaid diagrams or display equations in its responses, the terminal can now render them visually right in the output, eliminating the hassle of copying diagram code into external editors just to preview it.

items.original: Customize the terminal with six new themes and view supported Mermaid diagrams and display equations directly in responses. (#46504, #46054, #45612)

title.zh-TW: 支援 /daemon 指令更新背景伺服器，或用 --no-daemon 完全繞過
title.en: Support /daemon command to update background server or bypass it completely with --no-daemon

body.zh-TW: 想升級在本機默默運作的背景服務，或是想單次乾淨啟動而不依賴常駐程序？⟦正如給社區中央供水泵補上獨立升級開關，管理員隨時能下令進行設備更新，住戶若想測試自備水塔也能直接切換獨立閥門、完全不經過中央管線。⟧你現在可以在 Codex 裡輸入 `/daemon`，直接更新本機的守護行程（daemon，在背景持續運作的常駐服務程式）。如果這次不想經過背景伺服器，只要在啟動命令列加上 `--no-daemon` 旗標，就會直接繞過它。
body.en: Need to upgrade a background service running quietly on your local machine, or prefer a clean one-off launch without relying on a resident process? ⟦Just as a community water pump receives a dedicated upgrade switch so managers can trigger equipment updates at any time, residents can also turn an independent valve to test their own water tank without routing through central pipes.⟧ You can now use `/daemon` inside Codex to update the local daemon. If you would rather not go through the background server this time, add the `--no-daemon` flag when launching and it is bypassed.

items.original: Update the local background server through `/daemon`, or bypass it with `--no-daemon`. (#45854, #46088)

title.zh-TW: 對話中斷或編輯提示詞時，完整保留已生成的答案、計畫與設定
title.en: Preserve streamed answers, plans, and settings when conversations are interrupted or prompts are edited

body.zh-TW: 當你請 AI 規劃冗長步驟卻不幸碰上網路瞬斷、手動中斷，或是想回頭修改剛才的提問時，先前的心血不再瞬間歸零。⟦猶如繪畫師在長卷上作畫，即便畫到一半顏料用盡或臨時被電話打斷，已經勾勒好的底稿與著色計畫依然會穩穩留在畫布上；重新拿起畫筆時能立即接續先前的畫法模式，即使擦改前幾筆線條也不會弄丟整幅畫的圖層標籤與筆刷設定。⟧系統現在會在回合失敗、遭使用者中斷或接收到子代理完成事件時，妥善保留已經串流產生的回覆內容與執行計畫。當你重新續接工作階段時，先前開啟的 Plan 模式會自動精準還原；而在編輯更早之前的提示詞時，對話串的身分識別與自訂設定也能完整延續。
body.en: When you ask AI to plan complex multi-step tasks and run into network dropouts, manual interruptions, or simply want to edit a previous prompt, your earlier progress is no longer lost. ⟦When an artist paints on a long scroll, the sketched drafts and coloring plans remain firmly on canvas even if the paint runs out or a phone call interrupts mid-stroke; picking up the brush immediately restores the previous painting mode, and erasing earlier strokes never loses the layer tags or brush settings.⟧ The system now preserves streamed responses and execution plans when turns fail, are interrupted by the user, or receive subagent completion events. When you resume a session, previously activated Plan mode is restored accurately, and editing earlier prompts preserves thread identity and custom settings.

items.original:
Preserve streamed answers and plans when turns fail, are interrupted, or receive subagent completion events. (#45549, #46867)
Restore Plan mode when resuming sessions and preserve thread identity and settings when editing earlier prompts. (#45519, #45845)

title.zh-TW: 修復 tmux 與 SSH 剪貼簿轉發，貼上文字時保留 Tab 縮排
title.en: Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH, preserving Tab indentation on pasted text

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端連線或終端機分頁軟體工作時，複製貼上程式碼最怕遇到剪貼簿失效或縮排格式被壓扁。⟦跟在辦公室使用跨樓層文件輸送管一樣，遠端傳送的文件能精準送達收件匣，而且就算遇到老舊傳送機把整疊報表拆成單頁逐張送出，系統依然會依照原本的格線與分欄標記工整排好，絕不讓表格欄位錯位。⟧這次更新修正了在 tmux 與 SSH 工作階段中剪貼簿無法正確轉發的問題。同時，當某些終端機將貼上的大段文字拆成個別按鍵訊號逐一送出時，Codex 現在也能完整保留原始的 Tab 縮排格式，不再將排版打亂成純文字。
body.en: When working over remote connections or terminal multiplexers, copying and pasting code often risks broken clipboards or flattened indentations. ⟦Operating like a multi-floor document pneumatic tube system in an office, remotely dispatched files arrive accurately in the inbox, and even if an aging feeder sends a report sheet by sheet, the system arranges them neatly along original gridlines and column markers without misaligned columns.⟧ This update fixes clipboard forwarding failures in tmux and SSH sessions. Additionally, when certain terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes, Codex now preserves the original Tab indentation format rather than scrambling it into plain unformatted text.

items.original: Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH sessions and preserve tab indentation when terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes. (#45457, #45454)

title.zh-TW: 支援透過系統代理伺服器復原登入，修復 MCP 憑證 503 重新整理
title.en: Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials on 503 errors

body.zh-TW: 公司網路規定所有連線都得先繞經代理時，Codex 的登入以前容易卡在半路。⟦彷彿外賓進園區規定要走公司的接待櫃台，以前走這條路常被擋在門外，現在能照常換證進門；遇到換證窗口回「忙線中」時，櫃台也會主動幫你重換一張有效的通行證，不再讓你在門口枯等。⟧Codex 現在能透過系統代理伺服器順利復原登入工作階段，確保特殊網路架構下的認證暢通。此外，當外部伺服器的 OAuth 身分探索回傳 503 服務暫時無法使用錯誤時，系統會自動重新整理 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的授權憑證，提升外部工具連線的穩定度。
body.en: On corporate networks that route every connection through a proxy, Codex sign-in used to get stuck halfway. ⟦Picture a visitor who has to enter a campus through the company reception desk: that route used to leave them stuck outside, and now it gets them in; when the badge office answers "line busy", the desk now fetches a fresh pass instead of leaving them waiting at the door.⟧ Codex can now recover login sessions smoothly through system proxies, so sign-in works on networks that route traffic through a proxy. Furthermore, when OAuth identity discovery returns a 503 Service Unavailable error from an external server, the system automatically refreshes MCP (Model Context Protocol) authorization credentials, improving connection stability for external tools.

items.original: Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials when OAuth discovery returns a 503 error. (#46562, #44636)

title.zh-TW: 修補沙盒隔離漏洞，防堵連線穿透、特權通訊端與檔案寫入
title.en: Patch sandbox isolation gaps to block inbound connections, privileged sockets, and file writes

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 在受限環境中測試未知腳本時，環境隔離的防護邊界現在更加固若金湯。⟦類似給金庫隔離艙加裝多重防護閥，既封鎖了外部未經許可的傳入管線，又切斷了內部程式暗中調用高特權通訊通道的可能，並嚴格鎖死唯讀公文櫃的鎖扣、防止任何人偷偷提筆篡改。⟧這次更新修補了沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護環境）的數項隔離漏洞：堵住了涉及 Windows 傳入連線的漏洞、阻斷了 Linux 與 macOS 上存取特權通訊端的管道，並徹底禁止透過 macOS 唯讀檔案控制代碼進行寫入操作。
body.en: When having AI test unknown scripts in restricted environments, the protective perimeter of environmental isolation is now significantly tighter. ⟦Installing multiple protective valves on a vault isolation chamber blocks unauthorized inbound pipelines, cuts off covert attempts by internal programs to access privileged communication channels, and firmly locks read-only document cabinets to prevent illicit alterations.⟧ This update patches several isolation gaps in the sandbox: it closes a gap involving inbound connections on Windows, shuts down avenues for accessing privileged sockets on Linux and macOS, and strictly prohibits write operations through read-only macOS file handles.

items.original: Close sandbox isolation gaps involving inbound Windows connections, privileged Linux/macOS sockets, and writes through read-only macOS file handles. (#44639, #45984, #46500)

title.zh-TW: 淘汰舊版個性設定，釐清代理規則萬用字元並升級 TLS 套件
title.en: Retire legacy personality settings, clarify proxy wildcard rules, and upgrade TLS dependencies

body.zh-TW: 這批更新收攏了幾項設定規則、網路比對與底層套件的規格細節。官方明確釐清先前已標記為棄用的 `friendly` 與 `pragmatic` 個性設定，現在已不再對 AI 的回覆語氣風格產生任何影響。在網路代理的允許與拒絕比對規則中，規則說明補上了問號 `?` 代表匹配單一字元的定義，方便你寫出更精確的代理規則。同時，系統打包的 TLS 安全傳輸相依套件也完成升級，包含為 Linux musl 建置版本納入了 OpenSSL 3.6.4。以前如果對代理規則語法不確定或受限於舊版通訊套件，現在規則寫得清楚，打包的套件也更新到新版。
body.en: This batch of updates consolidates specification details across configuration rules, network matching, and underlying packages. The release explicitly clarifies that the previously deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer have any effect on AI response style. In network proxy allow and deny matching rules, the documentation now explains that the question mark `?` matches a single character, helping you write more precise proxy rules. Meanwhile, bundled TLS security dependencies have been upgraded, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. If you were previously uncertain about proxy rule syntax or constrained by older communication packages, the rules are now spelled out and the bundled secure-connection libraries are up to date.

items.original:
Clarify that deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer select response styles. (#45809)
Explain how `?` matches a single character in network proxy allow and deny patterns. (#46027)
Update bundled TLS dependencies, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. (#45149, #45489)

title.zh-TW: 開啟本機 TUI 畫面時預設關閉推理摘要
title.en: Local TUI sessions now disable reasoning summaries by default

body.zh-TW: 接的模型供應商不支援推理摘要，送出對話就被拒絕？你在終端機開啟本機 TUI（在終端機操作的文字互動介面）工作階段時，現在預設不會主動開啟推理摘要。預設關掉之後，這類供應商就能正常連線。⟦寄包裹時預設只填標準運送單，不再自動夾帶特殊電子格式，以前不支援該格式的代收店家會直接拒收包裹，現在所有站所都能正常收件；要是你特別設定要附，才會一併送出。⟧如果你先前已經在設定檔中指定過推理摘要選項，原本的設定依然會保留並繼續生效。
body.en: Requests rejected because your model provider does not support reasoning summaries? When you start a local TUI (text user interface) session in your terminal, reasoning summaries are now turned off by default. Leaving them off by default lets those providers connect normally. ⟦Think of sending a parcel with a standard shipping form instead of automatically attaching a specialized electronic slip: older partner shops that did not support the format used to reject packages on the spot, but now every station accepts deliveries normally unless you explicitly choose to include the extra slip.⟧ If you already configured explicit reasoning summary options in your settings, your preferences remain saved and will continue to work.

items.original: New local TUI sessions now leave reasoning summaries disabled by default, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them. Explicit reasoning-summary settings remain respected. (#46467)

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示詞可用 @ 指名子代理，自動補齊快速對話
title.en: Mention Subagents with @ in Prompts for Fast Messaging with Autocomplete

body.zh-TW: 當你同時開了好幾個背景工作幫手，想要單獨插話交辦新任務，現在只要在輸入框打個 @ 符號就能辦到。現在新增了 `@<subagent> <message>` 提示詞語法，能直接把訊息發給指定的子代理（subagent，在背景獨立處理特定任務的助理）。打字時只要輸入 @ 就會跳出自動補齊選單，清單會列出目前正在執行以及已經完成的子代理名稱。例如研究助理剛查完資料，你直接打 `@research 幫我整理成三點結論` 就能繼續追問，不必手動切換對話。⟦彷彿在專案群組裡打出標註符號，選單立刻列出在線與已完工的全部同事，點名就能直接交代待辦事項。⟧
body.en: When running multiple background helpers and wanting to chime in with a new task, you can now do so simply by typing an @ symbol in the input box. The newly added `@<subagent> <message>` prompt syntax lets you send messages directly to a specific subagent (an assistant handling dedicated tasks in the background). Typing @ brings up an autocomplete menu listing the names of both running and completed subagents. For example, right after a research assistant finishes gathering info, you can type `@research summarize this into three key takeaways` to follow up without manually switching conversations. ⟦Think of tagging someone in a project group chat, where a popup menu lists all active and finished colleagues so you can assign action items right away.⟧

items.original: Added `@<subagent> <message>` prompt syntax to send a message directly to a subagent conversation, with autocomplete listing running and completed subagents

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式支援數字倍數前綴，多行與區塊操作一氣呵成
title.en: Vim Mode Adds Numeric Count Multipliers for Multi-Line and Block Operations in One Go

body.zh-TW:
習慣在終端機裡用 Vim 快速修整文字的讀者，現在不用再狂按同一組快捷鍵了。編輯器現在支援數字倍數乘數，在一般模式（Normal mode，游標移動與執行指令的狀態）以及選取模式中，你可以在動作、移動與運算子前面加上次數。常用的整行刪除、貼上、復原、游標跳轉到指定行或選取多層括號區塊，都能直接加倍執行：

```
3dw    # 刪除接下來的 3 個單字
2d3w   # 執行 2 次刪除 3 個單字
3dd    # 刪除 3 行
3x     # 刪除 3 個字元
3rX    # 將接下來 3 個字元替換為 X
3p     # 連續貼上 3 次
3u     # 連續復原 3 次動作
5G     # 移動至第 5 行（支援 [count]G、gg 與 $）
2di(   # 刪除外層第 2 層括號內的文字物件
```

⟦如同給常用指令蓋上倍數印章，以前得連按好幾次按鍵的操作，現在敲個數字加指令就能一口氣整批執行完畢。⟧
body.en:
If you are used to editing text quickly with Vim in the terminal, you no longer have to mash the same shortcuts repeatedly. The editor now supports numeric count multipliers. In Normal mode (the state for moving the cursor and running commands) and Visual mode, you can prefix actions, motions, and operators with a count. Common operations like deleting whole lines, pasting, undoing, jumping to a specific line, or selecting nested bracket blocks can now run in multiples:

```
3dw    # Delete the next 3 words
2d3w   # Run delete 3 words 2 times
3dd    # Delete 3 lines
3x     # Delete 3 characters
3rX    # Replace the next 3 characters with X
3p     # Paste 3 times consecutively
3u     # Undo 3 actions consecutively
5G     # Jump to line 5 (supports [count]G, gg, and $)
2di(   # Delete the inner text object inside the 2nd outer bracket level
```

⟦Picture stamping your frequent commands with a multiplier mark, turning repeated keystrokes into a single batch execution with just a number and a key.⟧

items.original: Added Vim numeric count multipliers so counts apply to operators, motions, and actions in Normal and Visual modes, including `3dw`, `2d3w`, `3dd`, `3x`, `3rX`, `3p`, `3u`, `[count]G`/`gg`/`$`, and counted text objects such as `2di(`

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式守護程序正常退場，背景耗時任務不再被提早中斷
title.en: Headless Daemons Exit Cleanly and Long Background Tasks Run to Completion

body.zh-TW: 用腳本串接命令列工具來自動跑任務時，最怕背景工作沒跑完就被砍掉、或是執行結束後卡住不放。在以 -p 或 --prompt 執行的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的自動執行模式）下，以前程式退出後常殘留背景守護程序。這會導致讀取輸出的外部腳本一直等不到結尾訊號而卡死，現在常駐程序會在執行結束時確實終止。另外，以前助理只要閒置約 5 秒，就會誤把還在跑的背景任務直接取消；現在會持續等待背景任務完成，最長可等到 --print-timeout 指定的期限，上限為 30 分鐘。⟦跟自動化產線收工一樣，系統會等手上最後一件耗時組裝確實完工才打卡，下班時也會把廠房電源全數關閉不留尾巴。⟧
body.en: When scripting command-line tools to automate tasks, you never want background jobs killed prematurely or hanging indefinitely after execution finishes. In headless mode (an automated execution mode without a terminal UI) run with -p or --prompt, background daemon processes previously lingered after exit. This caused external scripts reading CLI output to hang while waiting for an EOF signal, but daemons now terminate cleanly when the run ends. Additionally, when the agent sat idle for about 5 seconds, it previously cancelled still-running background tasks by mistake. Runs now keep waiting for background tasks until the --print-timeout deadline, capped at 30 minutes. ⟦Just like wrapping up an automated assembly line, the system waits for the last time-consuming build to finish before clocking out, completely powering down the workshop without leaving anything behind.⟧

items.original:
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs leaving daemon background processes running after exit, which could hang scripts reading the CLI's output until end-of-file; daemon processes now terminate when the run ends
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs cancelling still-running background tasks about 5 seconds after the agent went idle; runs now wait for background tasks until the `--print-timeout` deadline, up to a 30-minute cap

title.zh-TW: 修復對話歷史資料庫損毀風險，改善上下文壓縮與串流穩定度
title.en: Fix History Database Corruption Risks, Context Compaction, and Streaming Stability

body.zh-TW: 當你同時開啟多個終端機視窗、或是進行超長篇對話時，底層資料庫與連線都不再無預警出錯。以前多個處理程序同時存取同一個對話歷史資料庫時，檢查寫入權限的動作可能會悄悄丟失檔案鎖（file lock，防止多個程式同時寫入同一檔案的鎖定機制），造成資料庫損壞風險。當對話過長觸發上下文壓縮（context compaction，自動濃縮歷史以節省空間的機制）時，部分情境下用於建立檢查點的工具設定曾遭到拒絕而導致壓縮失敗。模型串流回傳資料時，要是封包缺少外層回應信封，先前會觸發後端當機並以連線錯誤終止工作階段。現在這些資料庫鎖定、壓縮檢查點與串流封包解析問題都已修復。
body.en: When opening multiple terminal windows at once or having very long conversations, underlying databases and connections no longer fail unexpectedly. When multiple processes accessed the same conversation history database concurrently, checking write permissions previously risked silently dropping file locks (a locking mechanism preventing multiple programs from writing to the same file at once), creating a database corruption risk. When long chats triggered context compaction (a mechanism that summarizes history to save space), tool configurations used for compaction checkpoints were rejected in certain scenarios, causing compaction to fail. When the model streamed response chunks without an outer response envelope, it previously triggered a backend crash that terminated the session with connection errors. These database locking, compaction checkpoint, and stream packet parsing issues are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed a conversation-history database corruption risk where checking the database file for write access could silently drop file locks held by concurrent CLI processes on the same file
Fixed context compaction failing when the tool configuration used for compaction checkpoints was rejected in certain scenarios
Fixed a backend crash when a streamed model response chunk arrived without its response envelope, which terminated the session with connection errors

title.zh-TW: Markdown 跨行檔案連結不再破版，符號連結正確顯示名稱
title.en: Markdown Multi-Line File Links No Longer Break Alignment, Code Links Show Clean Text

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡查看模型產出的表格與程式碼清單時，畫面排版現在變得整齊乾淨。以前表格儲存格如果包含換行折疊的檔案連結，整張 Markdown 表格的欄位對齊就會歪掉破版；現在即使連結文字跨行折疊，欄位依然能維持精確對齊。另外，指向函式或類別等程式碼符號的檔案連結，過去常遺失自訂顯示文字，直接把長長一串原始檔案路徑印出來；現在修復後會正常顯示原本的描述文字。⟦就像排版整齊的型錄表格，即使品名附帶超連結且折成兩行，整欄格線依然筆直對齊，按鈕上也好好印著簡潔名稱而非冗長路徑。⟧
body.en: When viewing model-generated tables and code listings in the terminal, the layout is now clean and tidy. Previously, if a table cell contained a file link that wrapped across lines, the column alignment of the entire Markdown table would break. Even when link text wraps across multiple lines, table columns now maintain precise alignment. Additionally, file links pointing to code symbols like functions or classes often dropped their custom display text, rendering a long raw file path instead. This is now fixed so the intended descriptive text displays properly. ⟦A neatly formatted catalog table keeps its grid lines perfectly straight even when product links wrap across two lines, showing clean labels on buttons instead of raw file paths.⟧

items.original:
Fixed markdown table column alignment when a table cell contains file links that wrap across lines
Fixed markdown file links to code symbols dropping their display text and rendering the raw path instead

title.zh-TW: 登入行為一致化，未完成的企業驗證憑證自動清除
title.en: Consistent Sign-In Behavior and Automatic Cleanup for Incomplete Enterprise Credentials

body.zh-TW: 在不同登入方式之間切換、或是驗證中途斷線時，帳號狀態處理現在更順手。使用 GEMINI_API_KEY 環境變數啟動的工作階段，過去與一般登入路徑存在些許行為差異，現在已修復並減少兩者的行為落差。另外在進行企業帳號登入時，若在挑選授權或專案之前就關閉瀏覽器視窗，以前會殘留卡住的局部憑證（credential，記錄登入身分的授權資料）而無法重試。現在會自動清除未完成的殘餘憑證，讓你直接乾淨重試登入。⟦恰似訪客在發卡機前登記，若手續辦到一半中途離開，機器會自動收回未完成的臨時卡，方便下一回重新乾淨取證。⟧
body.en: Handling account states is now smoother when switching between sign-in methods or disconnecting mid-authentication. Sessions started with the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable previously had slight behavior discrepancies compared to the standard sign-in path, which are now resolved. Furthermore, during enterprise account sign-ins, closing the browser window before selecting a license or project previously left behind stuck partial credentials (authorization data recording sign-in identity) that blocked retries. Incomplete leftover credentials are now cleared automatically so you can retry sign-in cleanly. ⟦When a visitor registers at a badge kiosk and walks away halfway through, the machine retrieves the unfinished temporary card so the next attempt can start fresh.⟧

items.original:
Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to reduce behavior discrepancies with the non-API-key sign-in path
Fixed incomplete enterprise sign-ins (for example closing the browser window before finishing license or project selection) leaving behind a stuck partial credential; such credentials are now cleared automatically so sign-in can be retried cleanly

title.zh-TW: 成品檢視器顯示平移提示，回溯面板自動聚焦最新步驟
title.en: Artifact Viewer Shows Pan Hints, Rewind Panel Auto-Focuses Latest Step

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡查看生成產物或回頭翻找對話歷程時，多處介面細節變得更順手。當大型圖表超出視窗寬度時，成品檢視器（artifact viewer，瀏覽產出圖表與文件的介面）會在底部顯示向左或向右平移的提示。開啟 /rewind 回溯面板時，各步驟會標上相對時間，並在面板打開時自動聚焦在最新步驟。在指令授權方面，白名單建議現在能精準辨識 jj config 與 jj op 子指令，方便你直接設定永久允許。瀏覽器隨行頁面的分頁標題也修正為大寫縮寫的 Antigravity CLI。這些介面與指令辨識的修整，讓日常瀏覽圖表與回溯操作更俐落。
body.en: Several UI details are now smoother when reviewing generated artifacts or browsing past conversation history in the terminal. When a wide diagram overflows the window width, the artifact viewer (an interface for browsing generated diagrams and documents) shows a Left/Right pan hint in the footer. Opening the /rewind panel displays relative timestamps for each step and automatically focuses on the most recent step when the panel opens. For command authorization, allow-listing suggestions now accurately recognize jj config and jj op subcommands when offering to always allow a command. The browser companion page title has also been corrected to the capitalized acronym Antigravity CLI. These interface and command recognition refinements make viewing diagrams and rewinding history much crisper.

items.original:
Improved the artifact viewer to show a Left/Right pan hint in the footer when a wide diagram overflows the window
Improved `/rewind` to show a relative timestamp for each step and to focus the most recent step when the panel opens
Improved command allow-listing suggestions to recognize `jj config` and `jj op` subcommands when offering to always allow a command
Fixed the browser companion page title to read `Antigravity CLI` instead of `Antigravity Cli`

title.zh-TW: 長指令不再被截斷，上下文壓縮依全篇對話分攤預算
title.en: Long prompts stay intact as context compaction shares budgets across turns

body.zh-TW: 和 AI 來回聊上幾十輪之後，你最開始交代的那一大段需求，它還記得住嗎？以前上下文壓縮（context compaction，對話太長時自動濃縮歷史以省空間的機制）時，每段提問都只能分到固定的字數上限。就算後面幾句問答都很簡短，開頭落落長的初始提示詞（prompt）也會被削成一小截。現在改由所有提問彈性分攤預算，只要後續問題短，開頭的指令細節就能完整留下來。摘要與截斷預算也改照模型完整的上下文視窗（context window，模型一次能讀取的最大容量）計算，不再依較窄的壓縮觸發門檻計算，濃縮後的重點與背景任務清單就不會被提早切掉。⟦就像會議紀錄員依照整場會議的長度來分配紙張，以前每位發言人只能分到半頁，現在後面的人講得短，開頭主席的重要報告就能整段謄錄，結尾的待辦清單也不會被裁掉。⟧
body.en: After dozens of back-and-forth turns, does the AI still remember the long brief you started with? Previously, compaction enforced a rigid length cap on every captured user prompt, lopping off details from a long initial prompt even when all subsequent follow-up turns were brief. The user-request budget is now shared flexibly across all captured prompts, preserving the full context of long instructions whenever later prompts are short. Summary and truncation budgets are also now calculated from the model's full context window rather than the narrower compaction trigger threshold, ensuring compacted summaries and background-task lists are never cut short prematurely. ⟦Like a meeting secretary who allocates notebook space across the whole session: each speaker used to get a fixed half-page, but now brief follow-ups leave plenty of room to record the chair's opening remarks in full without trimming the closing task list.⟧

items.original:
Improved context compaction to spread its user-request budget across all captured prompts, so a long initial instruction is no longer truncated to a small fixed slice when the other prompts in the conversation are short
Improved context compaction to size summary and truncation budgets from the model's full context window instead of the compaction trigger threshold, so compacted summaries and background-task lists are no longer prematurely cut short

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援 PDF，多媒體檔案不再報格式不支援
title.en: Custom models support PDFs and stop throwing unsupported mime type errors

body.zh-TW: 在 `settings.json` 裡掛了自訂模型，一傳 PDF 或音訊就跳 `unsupported mime type`？以前丟這類附件、或讓工具輸出音訊與文件，都會直接卡住。現在自訂模型預設直接支援 PDF，而且會確實讀取 `modelFeatures` 裡針對 images、video、PDF 與 audio 的媒體旗標，各類多媒體檔案都能依照設定正常送給模型處理。
body.en: Added a custom model in `settings.json` and got `unsupported mime type` the moment you sent a PDF or audio? Previously, attaching these media files or having tools emit audio and document outputs would fail outright. Custom models now accept PDFs by default and strictly honor the `modelFeatures` media flags for images, video, PDF, and audio, allowing media files to pass to the model as configured.

items.original: Fixed PDF and audio tool outputs and attachments failing with `unsupported mime type` errors on custom models configured in `settings.json`; custom models now accept PDFs by default and honor the `modelFeatures` media flags for images, video, PDF, and audio

title.zh-TW: 按 Ctrl+G 開啟 Vim 不再卡死，編輯提示詞直連終端機
title.en: Pressing Ctrl+G to open Vim no longer hangs when editing prompts

body.zh-TW: 想要在終端機裡好好寫提示詞，按下 `Ctrl+G` 就能跳進 `vim` 這類全螢幕編輯器慢慢改。以前按下快捷鍵時，編輯器常因為輸出沒接對終端機而卡死，畫面上還會跳出 `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal` 警告，整個卡住不動。現在外部編輯器改在真實的終端機標準輸出（stdout）下執行，隨時按 `Ctrl+G` 都能直接打開編輯器，改完存檔離開就立刻回到對話。
body.en: When you want to compose prompts comfortably in the terminal, pressing `Ctrl+G` jumps into a full-screen editor like `vim`. Previously, pressing this shortcut could freeze the editor with a `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal` warning because its output was not connected to a real terminal. External editors now run against a real terminal stdout, so pressing `Ctrl+G` opens your editor immediately and returns you to the conversation as soon as you save and exit.

items.original: Fixed pressing `Ctrl+G` to edit the prompt in a full-screen terminal editor such as `vim` hanging with `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal`; external editors now run against a real terminal stdout

title.zh-TW: 語音聽寫超時草稿不再被清空，錄音滿三分半自動完成轉錄
title.en: Voice dictation no longer erases drafts on timeout and auto-finalizes at 3.5 minutes

body.zh-TW: 對著麥克風講了一大段需求，結果一個字都沒留下？以前錄音只要超過 4 分鐘，就會觸發時限錯誤直接宣告失敗，講了老半天的轉錄草稿也跟著全部消失。現在錄音只要滿 3 分 30 秒就會自動停止並完成轉錄，講完的內容會好好轉成文字，不再怕超時白講一場。
body.en: Talked into the mic at length, only to end up with nothing? Previously, recordings exceeding 4 minutes triggered a deadline error and failed completely, discarding the entire drafted transcript. Recordings now automatically stop and finalize at 3 minutes 30 seconds, reliably converting your spoken words into text so you never lose your progress.

items.original: Fixed voice dictation sessions longer than 4 minutes failing with a deadline error and erasing the drafted transcription; recordings now automatically stop and finalize at 3 minutes 30 seconds

title.zh-TW: 非企業帳號登入時不再看到 Google Cloud 的 Project ID
title.en: Personal sign-ins no longer see a Google Cloud Project ID

body.zh-TW: 只是用個人帳號登入，啟動畫面卻冒出一串看不懂的雲端專案代碼？以前非企業的個人帳號登入時，終端機頂端的啟動橫幅會誤印出 Google Cloud 專案代碼（Project ID）。現在修好了，個人帳號登入時不會再看到這串跟你無關的代碼。
body.en: Signed in with a personal account and saw a cryptic cloud project ID on the startup screen? Previously, non-enterprise personal sign-ins mistakenly showed a Google Cloud Project ID in the startup banner at the top of the terminal. This is now fixed, so personal sign-ins no longer see an ID that has nothing to do with them.

items.original: Fixed the startup banner displaying a Google Cloud Project ID for consumer (non-enterprise) sign-ins

title.zh-TW: 複雜步驟對話載入不再當機，分岔對話徹底隔離舊資料
title.en: Complex conversation steps load without crashes and forked histories stay cleanly isolated

body.zh-TW: 對話裡有子代理、排程這類步驟，重新打開時整個程式崩潰？以前對話裡只要有背景任務、子代理管理、訊息傳遞或排程步驟，重新載入或壓縮對話時就容易觸發堆疊溢位（stack-overflow，記憶體堆疊空間耗盡導致當機）而整台程式崩潰。另外，把對話分岔（fork，從既有對話的某個時間點複製出新分支）時，新分支以前會誤把分岔點之後的舊步驟輸出抄進來，跟分岔後產生的新步驟打架。現在這兩處都已修好，載入不再崩潰，分岔後的資料也乾淨隔開。⟦翻開厚厚的工作企劃夾，重讀多組交辦與排程紀錄時不會讓活頁夾散掉，從中途另存一份新企劃時，也不會把原本後半段的舊進度混進新計畫裡。⟧
body.en: Did reopening a conversation with subagent or scheduling steps crash the whole program? Previously, reloading or compacting conversations containing background-task, subagent-management, messaging, or scheduling steps could trigger a stack-overflow crash that halted the program. In addition, when forking a conversation, the new branch mistakenly inherited step output data from steps after the fork point, clashing with freshly generated steps. Both issues are now resolved: loading no longer crashes and forked histories stay cleanly separated. ⟦Picture a thick project binder: reviewing multi-team handoffs and schedules no longer bursts the binder rings, and branching a new draft midway stops old downstream milestones from cluttering the new plan.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a stack-overflow crash when loading or compacting conversations containing background-task, subagent-management, messaging, or scheduling steps
Fixed forked conversations inheriting step output data from steps after the fork point, which could collide with new steps produced in the fork

title.zh-TW: 修復背景資源洩漏，中途取消與結束程式都不再拖泥帶水
title.en: Background leaks fixed, canceled requests abort instantly, and CLI quits without delay

body.zh-TW: 命令列工具開了一整天，或是中途取消建立工作區，背景都不會再偷偷累積記憶體或霸佔資源。以前每個對話工作階段（session）都會漏掉背景輪詢器與計時器，開越久記憶體吃越多。要是你中途取消建立對話或工作區，背景還會傻傻繼續調度資源，現在只要取消就會立刻中止作業。想關掉工具離開時，以前也得乾等 5 秒強制逾時才能結束，現在關閉時會直接中斷未結的串流連線，按退出就能秒關。以前開久了電腦變慢、取消還佔資源、退出又得乾等的麻煩，現在一次全清乾淨了。
body.en: Running the CLI all day or canceling workspace creation will no longer leak memory or hold onto orphaned resources in the background. Previously, every conversation session leaked a background poller and timer, steadily accumulating memory over long sessions. If you canceled a conversation or workspace creation, the background continued provisioning resources; aborted requests now halt immediately. Quitting the CLI also used to force an extra 5-second wait for a timeout, but shutdown now severs open streaming connections immediately to exit on the spot. Sluggish memory bloat, stuck background provisioning, and slow exits are all resolved.

items.original:
Fixed a background poller and timer leaking for every conversation session, slowly accumulating memory over long-running sessions
Fixed canceled conversation and workspace creation requests continuing to provision resources in the background; aborted requests now stop immediately
Fixed quitting the CLI taking around 5 extra seconds before the process exited; shutdown now cancels open streaming connections immediately instead of waiting for a forced timeout

title.zh-TW: 產出物檢視器支援圖形渲染，數學公式與流程圖直接預覽
title.en: Artifact Viewer Supports Graphics Rendering with Direct Previews for Math Equations and Flowcharts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中開啟產出物詳細檢視器時，現在能直接看到圖形化數學公式與流程圖。⟦這好比在閱讀數位筆記時，原本只能看到由文字符號拼排的原始代碼，現在翻開內頁就像自動載入高畫質插圖，複雜的方程式與流程圖直接以視覺圖案精緻呈現。⟧新機制在支援 Kitty 協定的終端機中，能直接在檢視器畫面中渲染 LaTeX 數學公式（包括 `$$...$$` 與 `math`、`latex`、`tex` 程式碼區塊），以及 Mermaid 流程圖和循序圖。若終端機不支援該協定，畫面會自動切換為 Unicode ASCII 純文字作為備援。遇到較寬的圖表時，你可以使用左右方向鍵進行水平平移；隨時按下 `m` 鍵，還可在影像、ASCII 以及原始文字三種檢視模式之間循環切換。
body.en: When opening the artifact detail viewer in the terminal, you can now directly view rendered graphical math equations and flowcharts. ⟦It is like reading digital notes where you previously only saw raw code cobbled together with text symbols, but now turning the page automatically loads high-resolution illustrations, presenting complex equations and flowcharts in refined visual diagrams.⟧ On terminals supporting the Kitty protocol, the new mechanism renders LaTeX math equations (including `$$...$$` and `math`, `latex`, and `tex` code blocks) alongside Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams inline in the viewer. If a terminal does not support the protocol, the display automatically falls back to plain Unicode ASCII text. For wider diagrams, you can use the Left and Right arrow keys to pan horizontally. Pressing the `m` key cycles between Image, ASCII, and Raw text view modes at any time.

items.original: Added inline Kitty graphics rendering for LaTeX math equations (`$$...$$` and fenced `math`, `latex`, and `tex` blocks) and Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams in the artifact detail viewer, with Unicode ASCII fallback, Left/Right arrow horizontal panning for wide diagrams, and `m` to cycle between Image, ASCII, and Raw views

title.zh-TW: 提問互動提示操作升級，支援左右換題與自填預覽
title.en: Interactive Question Prompt Upgraded with Left/Right Navigation and Write-In Previews

body.zh-TW: AI 一口氣丟來好幾個釐清問題時，填答畫面現在讓你前後翻題，也看得出哪幾題已經答過。⟦好比填寫多頁的紙本問卷，現在你可以隨時往前翻閱已作答的題目確認細節，手寫補充的欄位會整齊謄在預覽處，已選項目蓋有清楚的勾選標記，翻到最後一頁時按下確認就能一次繳回整份問卷。⟧提示介面現在支援使用左右方向鍵在多個問題之間自由切換與回顧。若選擇自行填寫答案，確認送出後的文字會直接在行內即時預覽；已經完成選取的選項旁會標註勾選符號，讓整體作答狀態一目了然。當你瀏覽到最後一個問題時，直接按下確認即可一步完成整份送出。
body.en: When the AI asks several clarifying questions at once, the answer screen now lets you move back and forth between them and see which ones you have already answered. ⟦Much like filling out a multi-page paper survey where you can flip back to review answered questions, see handwritten supplementary notes neatly transcribed into a preview area, verify answered options stamped with clear check marks, and submit the entire questionnaire in one go upon confirming the final page.⟧ The prompt interface now supports using the Left and Right arrow keys to freely switch between and review questions. If you choose to write in an answer, confirmed text is previewed inline in real time. Answered options display check marks so your response status is clear at a glance. When you navigate to the final question, pressing confirm submits the entire set in a single step.

items.original: Improved the `ask_question` interactive prompt with Left/Right arrow navigation between questions, inline previews of confirmed write-in answers, check marks on answered options, and single-step submission on the final question

title.zh-TW: 自訂規則享有專屬額度，不再擠壓技能與外部工具
title.en: Custom Rules Receive Dedicated Token Budget Without Evicting Skills or External Tools

body.zh-TW: 載入龐大的專案規範與自訂規則時，其他擴充功能不再因為空間不足而被無預警捨棄。⟦宛如整理隨身行李箱時規劃了專屬夾層，即使放入整疊筆記也只會佔用該夾層的專用容量，並在分頁處整齊切齊，絕不會把隨身工具包或精密儀器擠出行李箱外。⟧系統現在為使用者與工作區規則分配了專屬的 20,000 個 token（AI 處理文字的計量單位）預算配額。超出上限的規則會在換行邊界處自動截斷，並透過檔案路徑與描述清楚列出超額清單。這項獨立配額確保了龐大的規則清單不會再擠掉技能、工作流程、子代理或 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）等重要工具。
body.en: When loading extensive project guidelines and custom rules, other extensions are no longer discarded without warning due to space constraints. ⟦Just like designing a dedicated compartment in a travel suitcase where a thick stack of notebooks only consumes that compartment's designated capacity and is trimmed neatly at page margins, preventing toolkits or precision instruments from being squeezed out.⟧ The system now allocates a dedicated 20,000-token budget for user and workspace rules. Oversized rules are automatically truncated at newline boundaries, with over-budget rules clearly listed by file path and description. This independent quota ensures that large rule sets no longer evict essential tools such as skills, workflows, subagents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

items.original: Improved customization token budgeting by giving user and workspace rules a dedicated 20,000-token budget (cutting oversized rules on newline boundaries and listing over-budget rules by path and description) so large rule sets no longer evict skills, workflows, subagents, or MCP tools

title.zh-TW: 預設代理工具組去蕪存菁，舊版搜尋與目錄工具退役
title.en: Default Agent Toolset Streamlined with Legacy Search and Directory Tools Retired

body.zh-TW: 代理一啟動就帶在身上的工具箱，這版拿掉了三個舊的搜尋與列目錄工具。⟦好比隨身維修包將已經被新型工具涵蓋的舊式單一扳手與量尺移出基本標配，讓隨身工具袋保持俐落；但若是特殊任務的作業手冊明確指名，你依然能隨時將它們放回工具箱中。⟧系統改進了工具配置基準線，將舊版的 `find_by_name`、`grep_search` 以及 `list_dir` 工具從預設工具組中淘汰。這項調整能精簡代理預設攜帶的工具清單，避免多餘工具造成干擾。若你的自訂代理依然需要這些舊工具，只要在設定檔的 `tools` 清單中明確列出，依然可以照常呼叫與使用。
body.en: The toolbox agents carry from the moment they start drops three legacy search and directory-listing tools in this release. ⟦Like a portable repair kit removing older single-purpose wrenches and rulers that are already superseded by modern tools, keeping the toolkit nimble while still allowing you to pack them back in whenever a specialized manual specifically demands them.⟧ The system refines the baseline tool configuration by retiring the legacy `find_by_name`, `grep_search`, and `list_dir` tools from the default toolset. This change streamlines the list of tools carried by agents by default, avoiding distractions caused by redundant tools. If your custom agents still require these legacy tools, you can continue calling and using them as usual by explicitly declaring them in the `tools` list of your configuration.

items.original: Improved the default agent and subagent toolset by retiring the legacy `find_by_name`, `grep_search`, and `list_dir` tools from the default baseline while keeping them available to custom agents that explicitly list them in `tools`

title.zh-TW: 外掛程式指令前綴與背景程序修復，升級快取清理更乾淨
title.en: Plugin Slash Command Prefix and Background Process Fixes with Cleaner Upgrade Cache Pruning

body.zh-TW: 外掛裝多了以後，指令名稱互相打架、升級完舊程式還賴在背景，這幾個毛病這版都處理了。⟦彷彿模組化機房在更換新組件時，主控端會徹底關閉舊機台的殘留線路並清空廢棄零件存放區，控制面板也不會因為零件名稱重複而印錯開關代號，停用的模組依然能隨時在總清單中找回。⟧系統修復了外掛技能的斜線指令在設定名稱自帶前綴時會出現雙重前綴（如 `/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`）的錯誤，並解決了多個外掛定義相同簡稱技能時指令遭到遮蔽的問題。外掛升級時，系統不再讓舊的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與 sidecar 行程在已刪除的安裝目錄中持續殘留運作。啟動時也會主動清理市集快取（把下載檔案暫存起來的空間）中已被取代的舊版外掛與暫存目錄。此外，已停用的外掛不會再因只查詢啟用項目的指令而自 `/plugin` 清單中消失，移除外掛時也強化了外掛識別碼的路徑驗證。
body.en: With several plugins installed, command names could clash and old processes could linger after an upgrade; this release deals with both. ⟦Much like swapping components in a modular server room where the controller terminates lingering connections from decommissioned units, clears out obsolete spare parts storage, prevents duplicate part names from printing incorrect switch identifiers on the panel, and still lets you locate disabled modules in the master inventory.⟧ The system fixes an issue where plugin skill slash commands received double prefixes (such as `/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`) when the frontmatter name already included the plugin prefix, and resolves command shadowing when multiple plugins define skills with the same short name. During plugin upgrades, legacy MCP servers and sidecar processes are no longer left running from deleted installation directories. Startup now actively prunes superseded plugin versions and staging directories from the marketplace cache. Additionally, disabled plugins no longer disappear from the `/plugin` list after enabled-only customization queries, and path validation for plugin IDs has been hardened during uninstallation.

items.original:
Fixed plugin skill slash commands being double-prefixed (`/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`) when a skill's frontmatter name already includes the plugin prefix, or being shadowed when multiple plugins define skills with the same short name
Fixed plugin upgrades leaving old MCP server and sidecar processes running from deleted install directories, and pruned superseded plugin versions and staging directories from the marketplace cache on startup
Fixed disabled plugins disappearing from the `/plugin` list after enabled-only customization queries, and hardened plugin ID path validation on uninstall

title.zh-TW: 終端機橫幅顯示企業專案，用量面板去除重複配額文字
title.en: Terminal Startup Banner Displays Enterprise Project and Usage Panel Removes Duplicate Quota Text

body.zh-TW: 兩個常看的畫面這版變清楚了：啟動時的歡迎橫幅，和查額度的 `/usage` 面板。⟦恰似車輛儀表板在重新整合後，頂部狀態欄直接標記當前連接的行車系統專案代碼，底部的油量指示條也移除了重複堆疊的小字，讓關鍵資訊一目了然。⟧企業帳號在啟動命令列工具時，啟動橫幅現在會在登入帳號與方案層級下方，清楚標示當前作用中的 Google Cloud 專案識別碼（Project ID）。同時，`/usage` 用量查詢面板也移除了每個進度條下方重複顯示的剩餘配額百分比文字，讓整體畫面更為清爽緊湊。
body.en: Two screens you look at often got clearer in this release: the startup banner and the `/usage` quota panel. ⟦Much like a redesigned vehicle dashboard that displays the active navigation system project code directly on the top status bar and eliminates redundant stacked fine print beneath the fuel gauge, making key information clear at a glance.⟧ When enterprise accounts launch the command-line tool, the startup banner now clearly displays the active Google Cloud Project ID beneath the signed-in account and plan tier. Meanwhile, the `/usage` panel removes the duplicate remaining-quota percentage text beneath each progress bar, resulting in a cleaner and more compact interface.

items.original:
Improved the CLI startup banner for enterprise accounts to display the active Google Cloud Project ID beneath the signed-in account and plan tier
Improved the `/usage` panel by removing the duplicate remaining-quota percentage line beneath each progress bar

title.zh-TW: 模型重試等待上限縮減至 30 秒，連線異常恢復更迅速
title.en: Model API Retry Backoff Capped at 30 Seconds for Faster Recovery from Connection Failures

body.zh-TW: 模型 API 一時連不上時，你不必再盯著停住的終端機乾等好幾分鐘。以前在觸發重試機制時，每次重試之間的退避等待時間會逐步拉長，單次最長甚至需要等待多達 4 分鐘，導致終端機長時間停滯。⟦這就像撥打客服專線遇忙線時，自動重撥系統改為最多每隔半分鐘重新撥號一次，不再讓你對著話筒乾等數分鐘才重試。⟧現在系統將單次重試的退避等待時間上限嚴格限制在 30 秒，縮短連線遇阻時的等待空檔，讓對話能更快恢復順暢交流。
body.en: When the model API briefly fails, you no longer have to stare at a stalled terminal for minutes. Previously, when triggering retries, the backoff delay between attempts grew progressively longer, taking up to 4 minutes for a single wait and leaving the terminal stalled for extended periods. ⟦This is like calling a busy customer service hotline where the automated redial system now tries again at most every half minute, instead of leaving you waiting on the line for minutes before redialing.⟧ The system now strictly caps the per-attempt retry backoff at 30 seconds, reducing idle waiting intervals during connectivity hiccups so conversations can resume smoothly much faster.

items.original: Improved model API retry responsiveness by capping per-attempt retry backoff at 30 seconds instead of waiting up to 4 minutes between attempts

title.zh-TW: 終端機退出渲染與無頭模式修復，背景日誌與記憶體最佳化
title.en: Terminal Exit Rendering and Headless Mode Fixes with Background Logging and Memory Optimizations

body.zh-TW: 如果你常用 `-p` 讓它在背景自己跑，或習慣在終端機裡清畫面、退出，這幾項修正都跟你有關。⟦好比後台自動化工作站一邊運作，一邊將各個工具的進度即時抄錄進專屬日誌檔案，同時定期整理過長的文件摘要以節省桌面空間，在操作員關閉工作站時也能乾淨還原周邊設備的通訊狀態。⟧系統將 Bubble Tea 框架升級至 v2.0.9，修復了終端機畫面渲染問題，以及在離開工具或清除畫面時 Kitty 鍵盤通訊協定堆疊的處理異常。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）使用 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行時，修復了偶爾漏掉背景任務等待通知的問題。背景 SDK 工具的執行進度現在會確實記錄至任務記錄檔中，並透過複製截斷的指令輸出預覽來降低記憶體用量。
body.en: If you often run it headless with `-p`, or routinely clear the screen and exit in the terminal, these fixes apply to you. ⟦Like an automated back-office workstation that logs individual tool progress into dedicated log files in real time while periodically tidying up lengthy document previews to conserve desk space, and cleanly restores peripheral communication states when an operator shuts down the workstation.⟧ The system upgrades the Bubble Tea framework to v2.0.9, resolving terminal rendering issues and anomalies in Kitty keyboard protocol stack handling upon exiting the tool or clearing the screen. When running in headless mode using `-p` or `--prompt`, an issue where background-task waiting notices were occasionally skipped has been fixed. Execution progress for background SDK tools is now reliably recorded in task log files, and memory usage is reduced by cloning truncated command output previews.

items.original:
Fixed terminal rendering and Kitty keyboard protocol stack handling on exit and screen clear by upgrading Bubble Tea to v2.0.9
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs occasionally skipping the background-task waiting notice, logged background SDK tool progress to task log files, and reduced memory usage by cloning truncated command output previews

title.zh-TW: 啟動命令列工具不再影響桌面版對話釘選與已讀狀態
title.en: Starting CLI No Longer Alters Desktop App Conversation Pinning or Read States

body.zh-TW: 以前在電腦上啟動命令列工具時，可能會意外干擾桌面應用程式（desktop app）的狀態，導致原本釘選的對話被取消釘選，或是已讀過的對話被重新標記為未讀。現在這個問題已經修好，啟動命令列工具不會再誤改桌面版應用程式中的對話標記與釘選狀態。
body.en: Previously, launching the CLI on your computer could inadvertently interfere with desktop app state, causing pinned conversations to be unpinned or read conversations to be marked as unread. This issue has now been resolved, ensuring that starting the CLI will no longer unintentionally modify conversation read flags or pinned states in the desktop application.

items.original: Fixed starting the CLI unpinning conversations or marking them unread in the desktop app

title.zh-TW: 選單列記憶體減半且刷新變快，HTML 報表二次載入縮短至 0.1 秒
title.en: Menu bar memory halved and refreshes faster, HTML report second load drops to 0.1 seconds

body.zh-TW: 讓電腦整天掛著 usage 監控用量，現在吃掉的記憶體和 CPU 都少了很多。實測顯示選單列記憶體從 263 MB 降到約 130 MB，每次刷新從 1.2～1.65 秒 CPU 降至 0.16～0.47 秒。Grok 紀錄只在帶花費時才解 JSON（22,491 行裡只有 212 行），無變動時直接沿用。歷史快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）略過來源檔已刪除的項目，並丟掉同一份 Claude 紀錄裡重複的行。這類重複行占快取項目的 57%；另外讓重複模型、專案與工作階段字串共用一份，並只重寫變動分片。今日與昨日合計改用本地日界線比較，升級後首次開啟會重讀紀錄重建快取。產生 HTML 報表時快取上限由 512 提高至 4096，第二次載入從 5.0 秒降至 0.1 秒。⟦會計師整理年度發票時，先把重複的抬頭合用同一個印章，沒變動的帳冊不再整本重抄，結算速度省下一大半時間。⟧
body.en: Leaving usage running all day to monitor consumption now takes far less memory and CPU. Benchmarks show menu bar memory dropped from 263 MB to about 130 MB, and each refresh dropped from 1.2–1.65 seconds of CPU to 0.16–0.47 seconds. Grok logs decode JSON only when carrying costs (212 of 22,491 lines), and are reused directly when unchanged. The history cache drops lines repeated within one Claude log (57% of cached entries), skips entries whose source file was deleted, shares a single copy of repeated model, project, and session strings, and only rewrites changed shards. Today's and yesterday's totals now compare against local day boundaries, and the first launch after upgrading re-reads logs to rebuild the cache. When generating HTML reports, the cache cap was raised from 512 to 4096, cutting the second load from 5.0 seconds to 0.1 seconds. ⟦An accountant organizing annual invoices reuses one stamp for duplicate headers and avoids recopying unchanged ledgers, cutting settlement time by more than half.⟧

items.original:
**The menu bar app uses about half the memory and far less CPU per refresh.** Measured on one machine with 1.6 GB of Claude logs and 596 MB of Codex logs: the memory footprint went from 263 MB to about 130 MB, and each refresh from 1.2–1.65 s of CPU to 0.16–0.47 s. Grok's `updates.jsonl` lines are JSON-decoded only when they carry `costUsdTicks` (212 of 22,491 lines), and the whole Grok result is reused while none of its files change. The history cache drops lines repeated within one Claude log (57% of cached entries), shares repeated model, project and session strings, and skips entries whose source file was deleted; only the cache shards that changed are rewritten. Today's and yesterday's totals compare against local day boundaries instead of converting every entry's time zone, and the source scan groups paths by their parts. The first launch after upgrading re-reads the Claude logs once to rebuild the cache.
**Generating the HTML report again no longer re-reads every log.** The report's parsers capped their file cache at 512, below a real install's file count, so a sequential scan evicted every file; the cap is now 4096, as in the menu bar's loader. A second load went from 5.0 s to 0.1 s.

title.zh-TW: 重新開啟 App 不再少算 Claude 花費，快取寫入計價回歸正確倍率
title.en: Reopening app no longer undercounts Claude spending, cache write pricing returns to correct multiplier

body.zh-TW: 重啟電腦或重新打開 usage 後，你看到的 Claude 花費不會再少算。以前程式將資料寫入硬碟快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）時，漏掉了「1 小時快取寫入」的筆數。這導致 App 重開後，這批寫入被誤當成費率較低的 5 分鐘快取計價（以輸入價格的 1.25 倍而非正確的 2 倍計算），算出來的花費因而偏低。用 `usage doctor` 跟 Claude Code 自己算的花費對帳，差距從 12% 降到 2%。Claude 的快取結構已升級，現有快取會以正確的倍率重新計算。⟦就像飯店櫃台的電腦重開機後，以前會把住一晚的客人誤登成鐘點休息，帳因此少算一截；現在重開機也會照原本登記的方案收費。⟧
body.en: After restarting your computer or reopening usage, the Claude spending you see is no longer undercounted. Previously, when writing data to disk cache, the program dropped the count of "1-hour cache writes". This caused the app, upon reopening, to mistakenly price these writes at the lower 5-minute cache rate (calculated at 1.25× the input price instead of the correct 2×), resulting in undercounted spending. Reconciling with `usage doctor` against Claude Code's own cost figures, the gap went from 12% to 2%. The Claude cache structure was upgraded, so existing caches recalculate with the correct multiplier. ⟦It is like a hotel front-desk system that, after a reboot, used to log overnight guests as short hourly stays and undercharge them; now it keeps charging the plan each guest actually booked.⟧

items.original: **Claude spending is no longer undercounted after the app restarts.** The on-disk cache dropped the count of 1-hour cache writes, so after a restart they were priced as 5-minute writes (1.25× input instead of 2×). `usage doctor`'s reconciliation against Claude Code's own cost went from 12% apart to 2%. The Claude cache schema was bumped, so existing caches rebuild with the right figures.

title.zh-TW: 解除安裝完整還原原本的狀態列，開關切換不再覆寫原始備份
title.en: Uninstalling fully restores the original status line, toggle switch no longer overwrites original backup

body.zh-TW: 你在安裝 usage 之前自己設定的狀態列，現在不會再被弄丟。以前在設定中關閉再開啟狀態列，程式會把當前的狀態列暫存在專門保存安裝前備份的欄位 `previousStatusLine`，導致原本的舊設定被蓋掉，日後解除安裝時找不到最初的設定值。現在開關改用獨立欄位儲存，即使在狀態列關閉的狀態下解除安裝，也能順利找回原本的設定。執行 `usage unsetup` 解除安裝時，除了還原 Claude Code、Codex 與 Grok 之外，現在也會一併還原 Antigravity 的狀態列，不再將其遺留在 usage 的腳本捷徑上。⟦租車出遊換上自己的導航架，還車拆下時車行依舊把原廠螢幕接回，不會因為中途切換過模式就弄丟原本的配備。⟧
body.en: The status line you set up before installing usage is no longer lost. Previously, toggling the status line off and on in settings caused the program to park the active status line under `previousStatusLine`, a field reserved for the pre-installation backup, which overwrote the original configuration and left uninstallation with nothing to restore. Toggling now stores state in an independent field, successfully restoring your original settings even if you uninstall while the status line is turned off. When running `usage unsetup` to uninstall, in addition to restoring Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, it now also restores Antigravity's status line instead of leaving it pointing at usage's script shortcut. ⟦Picture installing your own navigation mount in a rental car; when returning the car and taking it down, the agency still hooks the factory screen back up without losing the original gear just because you switched modes during the trip.⟧

items.original:
**Turning the status line off and on no longer loses the status line you had before installing usage.** The switch parked the live status line under `previousStatusLine`, the key that holds the pre-install backup, so a later uninstall had nothing to restore. It now uses its own key, and uninstalling while the switch is off restores the original too.
**Uninstalling restores the Antigravity status line.** `usage unsetup` restored Claude Code, Codex and Grok but left Antigravity pointing at usage's script.

title.zh-TW: 支援多個 Claude 目錄掃描，修復背景更新覆寫設定與 Hook 備援文字
title.en: Scanning multiple Claude directories supported, background update overwriting settings and hook fallback text fixed

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時會在多個環境目錄切換，或習慣一邊檢查軟體更新一邊調整偏好，日常操作現在更加穩定順手。當你在環境變數 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 中用逗號指定多個資料夾時，歷史紀錄掃描不再因預設單一路徑而當掉，選單列能持續正常刷新。背景檢查更新時，程式在連網結束後會先重新讀取最新的設定檔，解決 macOS 與 Windows 上剛改好的設定會被連網前的舊資料覆蓋回去的問題。精簡模式與接續工作階段的 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）在遺失翻譯檔時顯示的內建備援文字，已同步至最新 `i18n.json` 內容。英文精簡提醒也補回「Drop filler … and pleasantries」的動詞。兩支 hook 均已升級版本並會自動重寫本機副本。多專案切換與自訂偏好設定的使用者，從此不必再擔心設定被莫名還原或畫面停止更新。
body.en: If you frequently switch between multiple environment directories or adjust preferences while checking for software updates, daily workflows are now smoother and more reliable. When you specify multiple folders separated by commas in the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable, history scans no longer crash by assuming a single path, allowing the menu bar to refresh normally. During background update checks, the program now re-reads the latest preferences after the network request finishes, fixing an issue on macOS and Windows where freshly updated settings were overwritten by stale pre-network data. The built-in fallback text shown by terse-mode and session-resume hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) when translation files are missing has been synchronized with the latest `i18n.json`. The English terse reminder also restores the verb in "Drop filler … and pleasantries". Both hook versions were bumped and will automatically rewrite local copies. Users switching across projects and customizing preferences no longer need to worry about settings unexpectedly reverting or displays freezing.

items.original:
**Several directories in `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` no longer stop the menu bar from refreshing.** The history scan assumed exactly one Claude directory and crashed when a comma-separated list named more.
**A setting changed during an update check is no longer reverted.** The background update check saved the preferences it had read before its network request, overwriting anything changed meanwhile; on macOS and Windows it now re-reads them first.
**The terse-mode and session-resume hooks' built-in fallback text matches the translations.** The fallbacks, shown only when the translation sidecar is missing, had fallen behind `i18n.json`; the English terse reminder also gets back the verb in "Drop filler … and pleasantries". Both hook versions were bumped so installed copies are rewritten.

title.zh-TW: 官網手機版排版優化，CI 導入 Ruff 檢查並修復 Windows 測試
title.en: Official website mobile layout polished, CI adopts Ruff formatting check and Windows tests fixed

body.zh-TW: 用手機瀏覽 usage 官方網站，或是在不同作業系統參與專案開發時，閱讀與測試體驗都更為清爽。官網在 640px 以下的手機螢幕上，中日文段落取消了兩端對齊排版，讓窄螢幕閱讀更自然。安裝卡片內的 Homebrew 安裝指令現在能完整在一行內放下，而 Windows 訪客打開首頁時也會優先看到專屬的下載按鈕。在內部維護方面，持續整合（CI，自動驗證程式碼的機制）導入了 `ruff format --check` 檢查程式碼排版，全專案重排的紀錄也已收錄在 `.git-blame-ignore-revs` 中，讓 `git blame` 不會把每一行都算到這次重排頭上。夏令時間標題測試改用 `getattr` 呼叫 `time.tzset`，順利解決 Windows 系統因缺乏該函式而無法通過型別檢查的困擾。
body.en: Whether browsing the official usage website on mobile or contributing across different operating systems, reading and testing experiences are now much cleaner. On mobile screens at 640px and below, the website removes justified text alignment for Chinese and Japanese paragraphs, making narrow-screen reading more natural. The Homebrew install command inside the install card now fits cleanly on a single line, and Windows visitors opening the homepage see the dedicated Windows download button first. For internal maintenance, continuous integration (CI, an automated mechanism for verifying code) introduced `ruff format --check` to verify code formatting, and the commit for reformatting the entire project is recorded in `.git-blame-ignore-revs` so `git blame` does not attribute every line to that reformat. The daylight-saving title test now calls `time.tzset` via `getattr`, resolving type-checking failures on Windows due to the missing function.

items.original:
**CI checks formatting with `ruff format --check`.** The whole project was reformatted once, and that commit is listed in `.git-blame-ignore-revs`.
**The daylight-saving title test passes Windows' type check.** It calls `time.tzset` through `getattr`, since Windows has no `tzset`.
**Website on phones.** Chinese and Japanese paragraphs are no longer justified at 640px and below, the Homebrew command fits on one line in the install card, and Windows visitors see the Windows download button first.

title.zh-TW: App 圖示換成水墨貓，各平台標誌統一由腳本產出
title.en: App icon switched to ink-wash cat, all platform logos generated by a script

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 或 Windows 桌面上啟動 usage，現在會看見俐落的扁平水墨貓圖示。以前在 macOS 26 與 27 上，圖示會被系統關進灰框；現在依 Apple 格線畫成圓角方塊，不再出現灰框。所有圖示改由 `assets/brand/` 內同一套向量原檔（彩色、全黑、反白、字標、App 圖示）經 `scripts/make_app_icon.py` 產出：涵蓋 Mac 與 Windows 的 App 圖示、README 頭像、官網 favicon、apple-touch-icon 與 logo 橫幅。頁首小圖、社群預覽圖與區段標籤也換上新圖示並簡化版面，未使用的管家貓 `docs/avatar.png` 則已刪除。⟦鑄幣廠用同一套母模壓製不同面額的硬幣與印記，各處標誌都維持一致神韻。⟧
body.en: Launching usage on a Mac or Windows desktop now shows a clean, flat ink-wash cat icon. On macOS 26 and 27, the system previously trapped the icon inside a gray frame; it is now drawn as a rounded square following Apple's grid, eliminating the gray frame. All icons are now generated from the same set of vector source files in `assets/brand/` (color, black, reversed, wordmark, app icon) via `scripts/make_app_icon.py`: covering Mac and Windows app icons, the README avatar, website favicon, apple-touch-icon, and logo banner. The header mark, social preview image, and section tabs also adopt the new icon with a simplified layout, while the unused butler-cat `docs/avatar.png` has been removed. ⟦A mint presses coins and stamps of different denominations from a single master die, keeping the exact same character everywhere.⟧

items.original:
**New app icon: a flat ink-wash cat.** Every icon is now generated from one set of SVG sources in `assets/brand/` (color, black, reversed, wordmark, app icon) by `scripts/make_app_icon.py`: the macOS and Windows app icons, the README avatar, the website favicon, apple-touch-icon and logo banner. The app icon follows Apple's grid as a rounded square, so macOS 26 and 27 no longer put it inside a gray frame.
**The header mark, social preview image and section tabs use the new icon and a cleaner layout.** The unused butler-cat `docs/avatar.png` was removed.

title.zh-TW: Opus 5.5 補齊離線備援價格，用量表改標簡短名稱
title.en: Opus 5.5 adds offline fallback pricing, usage table switches to short name

body.zh-TW: 平時使用 Claude Code 呼叫最新的預設模型，現在離線也能算出正確花費。從 Claude Code 2.1.280 開始，Opus 5.5（`claude-opus-5-5`）已成為預設的 Opus 模型。然而先前的離線備援價目表遺漏了這筆資料，導致價格快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）一旦過期，該模型的花費就會被錯誤算成 $0。現在價目表已補上每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）輸入 $4、輸出 $20、快取寫入 $5 與快取讀取 $0.20 的定價，標準與 LiteLLM 完全一致。用量報表中的欄位也改為直接顯示「Opus 5.5」，不再印出冗長的原始識別碼。⟦計程車跳表機預載了最新的夜間加成費率表，就算開進收不到訊號的地下道，也能照常按新費率精準計費。⟧
body.en: Calling the latest default model in Claude Code now computes accurate costs even offline. Since Claude Code 2.1.280, Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) has been the default Opus model. However, the previous offline fallback price table omitted this entry, causing the model's cost to be wrongly calculated as $0 whenever the price cache expired. The price table now includes pricing of $4 input, $20 output, $5 cache writes, and $0.20 cache reads per million tokens, matching LiteLLM exactly. Columns in usage reports also directly display "Opus 5.5" instead of printing the lengthy raw identifier. ⟦Like a taxi meter preloaded with the latest night-surcharge rates, pricing remains accurate even when driving into an underpass with no signal.⟧

items.original: **Opus 5.5 has an offline price and a short name.** Claude Code 2.1.280 made Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) the default Opus model, but the fallback price table had no entry for it, so whenever the price cache had expired its usage was costed at $0. The table now carries $4/$20 per Mtok with $5 cache writes and $0.20 cache reads, matching LiteLLM, and the usage table shows "Opus 5.5" instead of the raw model ID.

title.zh-TW: Grok 缺少總紀錄檔時，各工作階段花費照常自動補回
title.en: Grok per-session spending is recovered automatically when combined log is missing

body.zh-TW: 查詢 Grok 的使用花費時，就算總紀錄檔尚未建立也不必擔心資料遺失。在先前的機制中，當總彙整檔 `unified.jsonl` 不存在時，系統會直接回傳空清單，導致個別工作階段在 `updates.jsonl` 裡記錄的花費跟著全部丟失。現在程式會將「檔案不存在」比照「檔案內容為空」來處理，照常從各工作階段的日誌中將花費完整補回，確保統計數據不會漏算。⟦抄表員發現社區總電表尚未安裝，便逐一抄下各分戶的獨立電表，依然能把整棟樓的用電度數完整拼湊回來。⟧
body.en: Checking Grok spending no longer risks losing data even if the combined log has not been created yet. Under the previous mechanism, when the combined log file `unified.jsonl` did not exist, the system returned an empty list, causing all spending recorded by individual sessions in `updates.jsonl` to be lost.
